name: day-trader-skill-metals
description: 8 Claude skills for day trading gold and silver (XAUUSD, XAGUSD via COMEX GC=F / SI=F): scan, news, entry and exit timing, a 10,000-replay time machine, lot sizing with leverage, risk checks and alerts, on a Dubai clock (session 12:00-23:30). Never places an order. Adapted from the India edition by Shakir C, based on Jake Schincariol's day-trader-skill (MIT).
